title: Warm Roasted Uruguayan Bean Stew
description: A hearty and creamy stew featuring roasted beans and sunflower oil, perfect for a monsoon day. This high-protein dish is a staple of Uruguayan cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roast the soaked and drained white beans in the oven with 1 tablespoon of sunflower oil for 20 minutes.
In a large pot, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of sunflower oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chopped red bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the canned diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Stir in the roasted white beans and bring the stew to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
